plain: Holiness; the quality of being sacred

webster.text: Holiness; state of being sacred or holy.

more.text: Goodness; purity; godliness; as the sanctity of love; sanctity of manners.
Sacredness; solemnity; as the sanctity of an oath.

example.quote: May religion, with sanctity of morals, prevail and increase, that the patriotic civilian and ruler may have the sublime, parental satisfaction of eagerly embracing every opportunity of mitigating the rigors of government, in proportion to that increase of morality which may render the people more capable of being a law to themselves !
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Rev. Mr. STILLMAN, February 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
